entities.summary: Yordan Sokolov, sometimes spelled as Jordan Sokolov was a Bulgarian jurist and politician, Minister of Internal affairs from 1991 to 1992, three mandates as an MP from January 1995 to June 2005, and Speaker of Parliament from 1997 to 2001.
